title: Scottsdale Oasis | Pickleball, Pool, Spa & Hoops
description:
Your private oasis for the perfect Scottsdale getaway—ideal for vacations, golf trips, family gatherings, or business retreats! The backyard is built for fun with a pool, hot tub, putt putt, fire pit, and two poolside gazebos. Inside, enjoy a brand-new pool table, arcade barrel, and plenty of space to relax.

*Putt Putt

 The space 
Welcome to your gorgeous private escape in the heart of Scottsdale, AZ! Just 6 minutes from the vibrant shopping and dining of Kierland Commons and Scottsdale Quarter, this stunning 5-bedroom, 3-bath property comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests. Whether you're planning a luxurious family gathering, business retreat, golf trip, or simply a relaxing getaway with friends, this retreat is designed to impress.

Step into a one-of-a-kind backyard oasis where resort-style amenities await. Enjoy a sparkling pool, rejuvenating hot tub, basketball court, putting green, cozy fire pit, and more! Come experience the perfect blend of relaxation and recreation in Scottsdale’s ultimate getaway!

 Other things to note 
Primary Guest must be at least 25 years of age to book this property.

Check-in is at 4pm
Check-out is at 10 am

The entire home is reserved for your exclusive use.  5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms. All bathrooms include shampoo, conditioner, body wash, lotion, hair dryer and hand soap.

Heated pool fee is $125/night. We recommend heating the pool in the months between October and May each year. We require at least a 3-day notice before your arrival if you'd like the pool heated. The pool must be heated for the entirety of your stay.

The backyard is fully fenced in for your privacy and safety, including a dedicated gate to keep the pool and hot tub secure when not in use.

We offer a full kitchen with all the essentials including pots, pans, oil and spices, coffee makers, ground coffee, crockpot, full-size oven, microwave and much more.   You’ll find a Laptop-friendly workstation complete with a printer, toner, paper and pens. Stay connected with our high speed Gigibit   Internet and WIFI for Zoom calls, webinars, gaming, streaming and all your social media and entertainment needs.   Relax in the in-ground hot tub, seasonally heated pool and enjoy plenty of pool towels and outdoor games.   Poolside chairs and two hotel-style daybeds welcome you to soak up the sun during the day and enjoy the backyard fire pit for cooler evenings. We also offer Hulu+Live TV, Disney+ and ESPN+ on the TV’s throughout the home including the outdoor TV to watch all the important sporting events or movies while splashing in the pool. You’ll find a fully stocked game closet with board games galore for days with inclement weather or when you need a break from the Arizona sun in the comfort of air conditioning. 

One of the many benefits of this stunning home is its proximity to all the local amenities Scottsdale and the greater city of Phoenix is known for. Only minutes away from grocery stores, shopping destinations, dining and restaurants. Extremely easy access to Sky Harbor Airport and downtown Phoenix only 20 mins away and less than 15 mins to Old Town Scottsdale and the rich and vibrant history, dining and nightlife to be found there. You’ll find premium Golf courses and entertainment venues minutes away as well.

GUEST VERIFICATION:
To help ensure a smooth and secure stay for all guests, the primary guest listed on the reservation may be asked to complete a quick verification process within 48 hours of booking, depending on the platform used to book the reservation.

Prior to check-in, guests may also be asked to sign a Rental Agreement that includes agreeing to our rental terms and conditions and, on certain booking platforms, providing a valid government-issued ID and matching credit card before arrival.

Included with your booking is our damage waiver coverage, which helps protect against accidental, self-reported damage during your stay when reported prior to check-out.
